heading.title: Of Discharge from Liability on Notes, Bills and Cheques

article.title: 5 [Drafts drawn by one branch of a bank on another payable to order.
article.content: where any draft, that is an order to pay money, drawn by one office of a bank upon another office of the same bank for a sum of money payable to order on demand, purports to be endorsed by or on behalf of the payee, the bank is discharged by payment in due course.]
article.html:
85A5[Drafts drawn by one branch of a bank on another payable to order.

Section 85A · Chapter VII · page 20 of the Act

where any draft, that is an order to pay money, drawn by one office of a bank upon another office of the same bank for a sum of money payable to order on demand, purports to be endorsed by or on behalf of the payee, the bank is discharged by payment in due course.]

5 Ins. by Act 25 of 1930, s. 2.
